environment.description: IoT telemetry ingestion service running on EC2 instance (m5.large) in private subnet. Service exposed via internal NLB on port 8443. Devices connect through IoT gateway which forwards authenticated messages. No request rate limiting configured on NLB or application layer. Flask app runs as root in Docker container with host network mode. Python 3.9 with pickle module available. Devices on firmware < 2.0 are permitted to use legacy_binary encoding.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough, no rate limiting
config.network: Private subnet, IoT gateway forwards all authenticated device traffic
